split_policy: Official identities retained; quarantine exact and visually confirmed cross-split duplicates from train/validation, always preserve test. Final counts: 1019 train, 1015 validation, 6149 test.
duplicate_policy: SHA256 audit removed train image 7307 and validation image 8077. Pre-training visual review confirmed validation/test near-duplicate pairs 1835/1858, 1929/1959, 7015/7040, 7029/8080; validation members quarantined. No models completed before this amendment.
training_budget_per_class: 10 except class 94 has 9 after exact-duplicate quarantine

accuracy_candidate.selection: validation log loss; ties favor smaller C

selection: C/epoch selected by validation log loss; per-encoder recommendation uses highest validation macro F1, ties use validation accuracy; never use test for selection.

performance.fixed_inputs: First 1024 test IDs sorted by content SHA, selection is independent of predictions

limits: Public fine-grained flower recognition is not document or industrial business acceptance.
Pretrained encoder exposure to public images cannot be ruled out.
No unknown-class claim; all test classes occur in training.
Three AdamW seeds measure initialization sensitivity on a fixed official split, not three independent datasets.
